title: incrementalCacheHandlerPath config stopped working from v13.4.13-canary.4

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: win32
      Arch: x64
      Version: Windows 10 Pro
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.12.0
      npm: N/A
      Yarn: N/A
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant Packages:
      next: 13.4.20-canary.3
      eslint-config-next: 13.4.15
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 5.1.6
    Next.js Config:
      output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

_No response_

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://github.com/pmi/nextjs-incremental-cache-bug

### To Reproduce

Run `npm run build` 

### Describe the Bug

`next.config.js` has `incrementalCacheHandlerPath` that used to work prior to [v13.4.13-canary.4](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/releases/tag/v13.4.13-canary.4) and was supposedly broken by [this commit](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/commit/22ca85946ee87a7af2d967565aeb4efa4b1ec978)

As far as I can see custom cache handler is being imported with require without accessing .default field. 
Previously used `require.resolve` worked fine. 
As a result the default export was not accessed and custom cache could not be created:
```
> Build error occurred
TypeError: CurCacheHandler is not a constructor
    at new IncrementalCache (C:\Users\pavel\Projects\Enonic\nextjs-enonic-demo\node_modules\next\dist\server\lib\incremental-cache\index.js:90:33)
    at initialize (C:\Users\pavel\Projects\Enonic\nextjs-enonic-demo\node_modules\next\dist\server\lib\incremental-cache-server.js:15:30)
    at C:\Users\pavel\Projects\Enonic\nextjs-enonic-demo\node_modules\next\dist\build\index.js:747:98
    at async Span.traceAsyncFn (C:\Users\pavel\Projects\Enonic\nextjs-enonic-demo\node_modules\next\dist\trace\trace.js:105:20)
    at async build (C:\Users\pavel\Projects\Enonic\nextjs-enonic-demo\node_modules\next\dist\build\index.js:148:29)
```

### Expected Behavior

Custom cache implementation should be created and used
